Rusk ISD education: 130 multiracial students were enrolled in schools in 2024-25 school year
C. K. Porter
There were 130 multiracial students enrolled in Rusk ISD in the 2024-25 school year, 3% less than the previous year, according to the Texas Education Agency.
Data showed that Rusk ISD enrolled 2,057 students during the 2024-25 school year. Among them, multiracial students comprised 6.3% of the student body to be the fourth most represented ethnicity in the district.
Rusk ISD roughly covers schools within Cherokee County and has a main office in Rusk.
Among the five schools in Rusk ISD, G.W. Bradford Primary School recorded the highest enrollment of multiracial students in the 2024-25 school year, with 40 students.
A 2026 study by WalletHub classified Texas as one of the least-educated states in the U.S., ranking it 41st out of 50 in educational quality and student outcomes.
Texas has the nation's second-largest K-12 public school system, serving about 5.5 million students with a student-to-teacher ratio of roughly 15:1.

| 2023-24 | 2,057 | 134 | 6.5% |
| 2022-23 | 2,055 | 116 | 5.6% |
| 2021-22 | 2,001 | 100 | 5% |
| 2020-21 | 1,969 | 83 | 4.2% |
